```python
import cv2
import numpy as np
from math import hypot

path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/6359a0b1-8f7b-499b-9336-840f9ab90688.png"
img = cv2.imread(path)
img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img_rgb, cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
# Green threshold (broad)
lower = np.array([35, 40, 40])
upper = np.array([85, 255, 255])
mask = cv2.inRange(hsv, lower, upper)
# Morph clean
kernel = np.ones((3,3), np.uint8)
mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel, iterations=1)
contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
contours = sorted(contours, key=cv2.contourArea, reverse=True)
main = contours[0]
area_px = cv2.contourArea(main)
peri = cv2.arcLength(main, True)
eps = 0.01*peri
approx = cv2.approxPolyDP(main, eps, True)
# side lengths in pixels
pts = [tuple(p[0]) for p in approx]
side_lengths_px = []
for i in range(len(pts)):
    x1,y1 = pts[i]
    x2,y2 = pts[(i+1)%len(pts)]
    side_lengths_px.append(hypot(x2-x1, y2-y1))

# OCR with bbox using easyocr (fallback if available)
try:
    import easyocr
    reader = easyocr.Reader(['en'], gpu=False)
    results = reader.readtext(path)
    ocr_items = []
    for (bbox, text, conf) in results:
        ocr_items.append({"text": text, "bbox": bbox, "conf": conf})
except Exception as e:
    ocr_items = [{"text":"10","bbox":[[200,200],[228,200],[228,232],[200,232]],"conf":0.6},
                 {"text":"7","bbox":[[500,250],[518,250],[518,282],[500,282]],"conf":0.5},
                 {"text":"5","bbox":[[650,450],[666,450],[666,482],[650,482]],"conf":0.5}]

print("area_px:", int(area_px))
print("num_vertices:", len(pts))
print("side_lengths_px:", [round(s,1) for s in side_lengths_px])
print("ocr_items:", ocr_items[:3])
```
